cards.description: The church identifies a Vacation Bible School program in its official YouTube video title. Activities are not described in the accessible program text.
cards.review_notes: Confirm that Vacation Bible School will be offered in summer 2027 and obtain dates, eligibility, activities, registration details and the drop-off location directly from the church. The accessible YouTube title confirms only the program name, not its year. The church publishes its address as 801 W Watauga Ave., Johnson City, TN 37604, but the accessible official sources do not explicitly identify it as the VBS drop-off location.
